definitions.explanation: The political party or coalition that holds government power.

examples.japanese: {与党|よとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party submitted the bill.

examples.japanese: {与党|よとう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The conflict between the ruling and opposition parties continues.

examples.japanese: {与党|よとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party won the election.

notes:
{与党|よとう} means the ruling party or party in power. The kanji combine ⟦{与|よ}→与：noentry⟧ (participate/give) + ⟦{党|とう}→党：noentry⟧ (party).

KEY CONTRAST:
- {与党|よとう}: ruling party (in power)
- ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: opposition party (not in power)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {与党|よとう}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: ruling party member
- ⟦{連立|れんりつ}→連立：14492_renritsu⟧{与党|よとう}: coalition government parties
- ⟦{与|よ}→与：noentry⟧⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: ruling and opposition parties

RELATED POLITICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧: administration, political power
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧: cabinet
- ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧: prime minister
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧: National Diet (parliament)
